description: Shared Renovate preset for yusufaf repositories

packageRules.description: Majors wait as Dependency Dashboard checkboxes instead of taking PR slots. Security fixes bypass this: Renovate force-applies vulnerabilityAlerts after these rules

One weekly PR for minor/patch updates of stable (>=1.0) dependencies, automerged once required checks pass. One PR means one lockfile rebase and one CI run, not one per package. The pre-1.0 pattern here and in the next two rules must stay identical (one negated)
Pre-1.0 minor/patch updates can break (semver allows it), so they get their own PR that waits for review
Overrides and resolutions are security floors under parents that pin a version line; a 0.x minor bump is breaking, so it needs dashboard approval, in its own group so it can't stall the pre-1.0 group
One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps, typed ci so release-please ignores it
Actions minor/patch bumps automerge; SHA pins and digest updates do not
Container image bumps (Dockerfile, compose, ...) deploy apps (fly.io) and may run migrations; always review, in their own PR
